Ana: Planning a focused 72h 'sculpt' next Mon-Wed to reduce post-launch noise. Goal: close top-customer bugs, ship 1-2 <2d delights, and trim stale backlog.

Devin: Sounds good. Guardrails?

Mira: Anything >2 dev-days gets deferred to 'sculpt-followup' unless P0. Require repro + acceptance checklist before starting work.

Jamal: Ops note: two fixes touch routing; need canary windows.

Kevin: We can support two 90m canaries/day. PRs must include rollback playbook for runtime changes. No runtime changes without a canary plan.

triage-bot: backlog-snapshot: open=128, P0=1, P1=11, quick-delights=6. link: https://redwood.internal/backlog/1789997777

Devin: Proposed shortlist: embed regression (P1), prompt truncation (P1), remove legacy routing flag (quick-delight), bulk-close low-signal bugs (housekeeping).

Mira: I'll produce a repro corpus for embed regression and tag customers.

Ana: Acceptance checklist for each item: repro steps, tests updated, canary run 2h with no errors, smoke eval >=95%.

Jamal: If canary fails we rollback and open triage. Include config diffs in PRs.

Kevin: I'll add canary + rollback templates to the repo and update the PR checklist.

Devin: I'll own quick-delight PRs; ETA draft PRs tomorrow 10am PT.

Mira: I'll publish heatmap + repro links and mark top 5 P1s.

Ana: Decision: prioritize P0 and top two P1s by customer impact (embed regression + truncation), ship legacy flag removal as quick-delight, reserve half-day for bulk triage. No new features beyond these.

triage-bot: created ticket sculpt-1789997777 with checklist and invites.

Ana: Final rule: if a fix grows beyond 2 dev-days, flag immediately and move to sculpt-followup unless P0. Keep PRs small.

Devin: Ack.

Mira: Will flag growth.

Jamal: Ops prepping hotline.

Ana: Kickoff 30m Tue 11:15 PT. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
